subject.title: feat(agents): screen tool drives Control UI layout (ui.command channel)

question: Should an agent screen command affect every connected capable Control UI, or only the Control UI connection associated with the originating turn?
rationale: The PR deliberately implements global fan-out while the canonical issue proposed session-scoped delivery; tests cannot determine which multi-client experience maintainers intend.

options.title: Target Originating UI
options.body: Route commands to the capable Control UI connection associated with the turn so unrelated tabs and devices retain their layouts.

options.title: Keep Global Fan-Out
options.body: Synchronize every capable Control UI, with explicit documentation and live multi-client proof showing this behavior is intentional.

recommendation.title: Target Originating UI
recommendation.body: Route commands to the capable Control UI connection associated with the turn so unrelated tabs and devices retain their layouts.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature design and current implementation originate from this person's broader agent-capability and presentation-tier work.
